primary_endpoint: Mean relative reduction from baseline in MRI-PDFF-measured liver fat content at 24 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: At 24 weeks, liver fat content decreased by 72.7% with efinopegdutide and 42.3% with semaglutide (p<0.0001).
safety_signal: AEs occurred in 88.9% with efinopegdutide and 72.6% with semaglutide; discontinuations due to AEs were 5.6% and 0%, respectively. Serious AEs affected 1 participant in each group; there were no deaths.
